name: Princess Kingdom
release_name: Background polish, framed footer and update notice
changes: Eliminated horizontal light/yellow artifacts from the lower part of the embedded artwork.
Replaced vertically stretched lower background with a naturally scaled repeating garden/paving extension.
Restored a distinct gold frame around the footer while keeping the garden background visible behind it.
Added version.json, version.txt and CHANGELOG.md for explicit version control.
Added a branded update notice shown while an installed PWA downloads a new version.
Kept automatic Service Worker updates and offline fallback; localStorage progress is preserved.
